## [2.2.1] - 2026-11-11

### Fixed

- [MAINT-SDP-0019] Publish the previously local SDPTool capability set from source 34ee535fbf6257b73d2fa0c7fbe4f9d5131aaf5e. XFMD can request complete VP01–VP11 overview documents through advertised overviewTarget values, including source provenance and model-revision checks. Earlier 2.2.0 did not advertise these targets.
- [KB-SDP-032] Include deferred SDL discovery and revision-bound expansion already integrated in source. Existing eager discovery and detail selections remain supported.

### Changed

- [PLAN-SDP-0018] The equivalent source also includes the existing ProjectGovernance CLI/JSON/MCP and bounded Session/leader workflow increments. This release does not certify completion of ProjectGovernance: integrated model lifecycle, full multi-Master admission/supervision, in-flight reconciliation and sustained recovery/capacity acceptance remain open.
- [MAINT-SDP-0019] Version 2.2.1 is explicitly selected by the owner for this distribution reconciliation; the source delta from public 2.2.0 includes additive capabilities. Framework/language/wire versions remain independent. Only Linux amd64 is packaged.

### Migration

- [MAINT-SDP-0019] Update to gh-sdp 0.2.3 for the new Linux publisher key and pinned 2.2.1 default. Earlier clients do not trust the Linux signing key; SDP_RELEASE alone cannot add trust. Existing laptop-signed releases remain supported. Project SDP-directory upgrades remain separate from client installation and are not required for viewpoint generation. This release does not update the XFMD application.
- [MAINT-SDP-0019] XFMD 0.8 supports an explicit XFMD_SDP_TOOL executable; XFMD 0.9 additionally discovers its private companion. Empty or incomplete authored models still produce empty or incomplete views. Source/template upgrades remain explicit and preserve project-owned documents.
